verdict.rationale: Fellow is a SaaS meeting-notes platform, so an official CLI is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence documents a REST Developer API, webhooks, an MCP server and a ReadMe 'Try It!' panel, but no official command-line tool. A REST API is only a developer building block and an MCP server is a separate capability, so neither counts toward a CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
